scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run worker:dev --prefix server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:client && npm run typecheck:server
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
